# **![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1052/219/curseforge_logo.png)**

歡迎在整合包中使用本模組

### **貼圖問題** 如果貼圖無法正確載入，請將 **Mod Resources** 資源包置於資源包列表的最上方。


精簡版
https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/souls-like-bosses-lite

獨立版本：
https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/soul-of-cinder-standalone

https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/nightlord-standalone

https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/abyss-watchers-standalone

## 所需模組 * **至少需要配置 6 GB 記憶體** * Huge Structure Blocks [https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/huge-structure-blocks](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/huge-structure-blocks) * AttributeFix [https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/attributefix](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/attributefix) ### **如果您喜歡這個模組，歡迎考慮在 Patreon 上支持我 :)** [![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/856/404/patreon.png)](https://patreon.com/bananaphoneminecraftmods) undefined # **Boss 戰** 夜之主 深淵守望者 灰燼之魂 梅爾科 洛里亞克
詛咒向日葵 ## Boss 場地 * **光明之樹** 生成於海洋生物群系中 * **卡希斯地下墓穴** 生成於深暗之域中 * **初火熔爐** 生成於山地生物群系中 * **洛里亞克城堡** 生成於平原生物群系中 * **梅爾科要塞** 生成於靈魂沙谷地生物群系中 undefined # 常見問題與設定 ### 貼圖問題 如果貼圖無法正確載入，請將 **Mod Resources** 資源包置於資源包列表的最上方。 ### Boss 凍結問題 如果 Boss 被凍結，請使用指令： /scoreboard players add .s\_l\_b\_global boss\_active 1 ### Boss 生成與傷害 /function souls\_like\_bosses:adjust\_config/ ### 1 對 1 生物戰鬥 安裝 Carpet Mod 後，即可啟用 1v1 生物戰鬥功能 [https://modrinth.com/mod/neoforge-carpet](https://modrinth.com/mod/neoforge-carpet) /function souls\_like\_bosses:adjust\_config/mob\_battle\_mark\_nearest\_mob ### Boss 解鎖進度 預設情況下，Boss 會依序解鎖。 若要從一開始即可挑戰所有 Boss： /function souls\_like\_bosses:adjust\_config/progression\_mode\_toggle ### 尋找 Boss 建築 /locate structure souls\_like\_bosses:catacombs\_of\_carthus /locate structure souls\_like\_bosses:kiln\_of\_the\_first\_flame /locate structure souls\_like\_bosses:lothric\_castle /locate structure souls\_like\_bosses:tree\_of\_light /locate structure souls\_like\_bosses:melkors\_keep ### Boss 生命值設定 Min: 100 | Max: 490000 /scoreboard players set .s\_l\_b\_global aw\_health number /scoreboard players set .s\_l\_b\_global soc\_health number /scoreboard players set .s\_l\_b\_global lothran\_health number /scoreboard players set .s\_l\_b\_global nl\_health number /scoreboard players set .s\_l\_b\_global te\_health number (melkor) ### 連擊長度設定 /scoreboard players set .s\_l\_b\_global aw\_combo\_length number /scoreboard players set .s\_l\_b\_global soc\_combo\_length number /scoreboard players set .s\_l\_b\_global nl\_combo\_length number /scoreboard players set .s\_l\_b\_global te\_combo\_length number ## **將 Boss 加入您的自訂建築** 我已上傳僅包含 Boss 的精簡版，可用於整合至自訂建築中： [https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/souls-like-bosses-lite](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/souls-like-bosses-lite) ## **透過輔助數據包設定整合包** 您可以使用輔助數據包來設定本模組。 請在您的 load.mcfunction 中使用以下程式碼並調整數值。 ``` # --- 建立計分板目標 --- scoreboard objectives add gamerule_keep_inventory dummy # 1=死亡時保留物品，2=掉落物品 scoreboard objectives add boss_difficulty dummy # 1=簡單，2=普通，3=困難，4=極難，5=硬核 scoreboard objectives add bossbars_enabled dummy # 1=顯示 Boss 血條，2=隱藏 Boss 血條 scoreboard objectives add dialogue_audio_enabled dummy # 1=開啟語音，2=關閉語音 scoreboard objectives add slb_ability_cooldown dummy # 玩家技能冷卻時間 scoreboard objectives add heolstor_spawned dummy # 0=遊戲開始時生成 # 所有角色生命值目標（最小 100，最大 490,000） scoreboard objectives add nl_health dummy # 夜之主生命值 scoreboard objectives add soc_health dummy # 灰燼之魂生命值 scoreboard objectives add aw_health dummy # 深淵守望者生命值 # 連擊長度目標 scoreboard objectives add nl_combo_length dummy # 夜之主平均連擊長度 scoreboard objectives add soc_combo_length dummy # 灰燼之魂平均連擊長度 scoreboard objectives add aw_combo_length dummy # 深淵守望者平均連擊長度 # 一般設定 scoreboard players set .s_l_b_global gamerule_keep_inventory 1 scoreboard players set .s_l_b_global boss_difficulty 2 scoreboard players set .s_l_b_global bossbars_enabled 1 scoreboard players set .s_l_b_global dialogue_audio_enabled 2 scoreboard players set .s_l_b_global slb_ability_cooldown 1600 scoreboard players set .s_l_b_global heolstor_spawned 0 # Boss 生命值數值 scoreboard players set .s_l_b_global nl_health 600 scoreboard players set .s_l_b_global soc_health 400 scoreboard players set .s_l_b_global aw_health 400 # Boss 連擊長度 scoreboard players set .s_l_b_global nl_combo_length 2 scoreboard players set .s_l_b_global soc_combo_length 2 scoreboard players set .s_l_b_global aw_combo_length 2 ``` # **鳴謝** * 夜之主模型由 chromexception 製作 * 月光大劍模型 [https://www.planetminecraft.com/data-pack/custom-sword-datapack-moonlight-great-sword/](https://www.planetminecraft.com/data-pack/custom-sword-datapack-moonlight-great-sword/) * 防火女大劍模型 [https://www.planetminecraft.com/texture-pack/ds3-firelink-greatsword-no-optifine/](https://www.planetminecraft.com/texture-pack/ds3-firelink-greatsword-no-optifine/) * 法隆大劍模型 [https://www.planetminecraft.com/texture-pack/ds3-abyss-watchers/](https://www.planetminecraft.com/texture-pack/ds3-abyss-watchers/) * 灰燼之魂貼圖 [https://www.planetminecraft.com/skin/soul-of-cinder-dark-souls-iii-6146273/](https://www.planetminecraft.com/skin/soul-of-cinder-dark-souls-iii-6146273/) * 初火熔爐建築結構 [https://www.planetminecraft.com/project/dark-souls-3-kiln-boss-fight/](https://www.planetminecraft.com/project/dark-souls-3-kiln-boss-fight/)
